subject: Processor substitution notice & risk review: EdgePulse (analytics) taking over FastEdge
messages:
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@edgepulse.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@edgepulse.com
Date: 2026-04-25T08:12:00Z
Subject: Notice: temporary processor reassignment for analytics pipeline

Hi Laura and Aditya,

Quick heads-up from EdgePulse — we need to temporarily assume processing for Redwood's analytics pipeline for EU customers starting 2026-05-01 for an estimated 3–4 weeks while FastEdge applies a critical runtime patch. This will involve: 

- Redirecting aggregated telemetry (non-identifiable usage metrics and service-level logs) through EdgePulse's EU cluster for the duration.
- No change to PII-level application logs — those remain with FastEdge and Redwood storage.

Attached is a short notice (edgepulse_reassign_notice.pdf) describing the scope and planned controls. Key points:
- Data categories: aggregated telemetry, anonymized performance metrics, minimal routing headers (no user message content).
- Purpose: operational continuity; no analytics model training.
- Retention: 30 days in EdgePulse environment with auto-delete policy.

We know this is a sensitive subprocessor swap; we can provide: dataflow diagram, SOC 2 summary, encryption attestations, and a sample redacted log extract by EOD. We have also prepared a one-page amendment (DocuSign) to the DPA to cover the temporary processor change.

Please let us know the quickest evidence you need and any hard blockers. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Regards,
Marta Gonzalez
Head of Partnerships, EdgePulse
Attachments: edgepulse_reassign_notice.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@edgepulse.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-25T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary processor reassignment for analytics pipeline

Marta — thanks for the notice and for being proactive. A few clarifying asks so Security & Legal can triage quickly: 

1) Please confirm exactly which fields will transit to EdgePulse (example CSV header names or schema).
2) Provide the dataflow.drawio you mentioned (we need the EU cluster routing diagram).
3) SOC 2 summary and the most recent audit date (attachment ok).
4) Encryption: confirm key management (do you use customer-managed KMS or EdgePulse-managed keys?) and TLS configs for in-flight.
5) Retention and deletion proof: how will auto-delete be validated?
6) Any subprocessors EdgePulse will call (CDN, logging vendor) and their residency.

Operational ask: we need a redlined one-page DPA amendment (DocuSign) + a contact for live verification during the cutover (SRE ops). Please send the attachments and a link to the DocuSign by EOD today so we can circulate to Legal/Security.

Note: aditya — can you hold outreach to the customer comms team until we sign off?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@edgepulse.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, ops@edgepulse.com, legal@edgepulse.com
Date: 2026-04-25T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary processor reassignment for analytics pipeline

Laura — thanks for the checklist. Attached: edgepulse_soc2_summary.pdf and edgepulse_dataflow.drawio. We use EdgePulse-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys; the in-flight is TLS1.3 with mutual auth. Retention is implemented via lifecycle policy that deletes objects 30 days after ingest; we can provide a signed attestation and a short video of the deletion policy being exercised.

Subprocessors for this path: 
- FastCDN (EU nodes) — caching only (no logs stored).
- LogStoreX (EU) — for short-term buffering; we are subcontracting for <30 days and have a DPA with them.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/edgepulse-amendment-12345 (amendment is one page; includes scope + limited liability clause).

Attached files: edgepulse_soc2_summary.pdf, edgepulse_dataflow.drawio.

If helpful, ops@edgepulse.com (cc'd) can be on a technical call this afternoon (14:00–16:00 UTC).

Regards,
Marta

Attachments: edgepulse_soc2_summary.pdf, edgepulse_dataflow.drawio
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@edgepulse.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-25T15:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary processor reassignment for analytics pipeline

Marta — thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments; I reviewed edgepulse_dataflow.drawio and have some technical questions before we approve: 

- KMS: You mentioned EdgePulse-managed HSM-backed keys. Are keys multi-tenant or dedicated per Redwood? We require per-customer key scoping for EU accounts.
- LogStoreX: how long do they buffer logs? Will logs ever leave EU jurisdictions?
- Proof of deletion: a video is nice, but we need either a verifiable audit log entry (sample redacted) showing deletion events, or an API we can call pre/post cutover to confirm deletion.
- Network egress: confirm there is no fallback to non-EU endpoints if EU capacity is exceeded.

Can ops@edgepulse.com provide the sample redacted deletion log and confirm the KMS tenancy model? We can take a 30-minute call at 15:30 UTC today if that's easier. Please include a technical contact in the reply.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-26T09:00:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Notice: temporary processor reassignment for analytics pipeline — PAUSE rollout pending evidence

Aditya — looping you in to pause any communications and block the scheduled switch until Security signs off. Neha has flagged KMS tenancy and deletion proof as blockers; legal will also want the DocuSign amendment redline. Please confirm outreach to the customer comms and Sales Ops teams is on hold.

For transparency, forwarding the messages below. Once EdgePulse provides the redacted deletion log and confirms per-customer key scoping, we'll resume. If they push timeline, we should escalate to Legal for an SLA/insurance carve-out.

Laura
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
